dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median slate-grey pixel intensity throughout the dorsal area, characteristic of a juvenile or sub-adult phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters localized primarily on the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the baseline grey pigmentation and localized darker mottled regions.
